title: Add HDR UAV output and fullscreen composite to swapchain
motivation: We need a stable path for high-precision volumetric output. Render into an HDR UAV (R16G16B16A16_FLOAT) and composite to the swapchain RT. This also decouples DXR/compute writes from presentation.
deliverables: Create size-dependent HDR texture with UAV/RTV/SRV views as needed
On resize, recreate HDR and RTVs safely
Fullscreen triangle/blit PSO to sample HDR SRV and write to backbuffer RTV
Wire DXR path to write to HDR UAV, raster fallback clears HDR and composites
acceptance: Application shows the same animated gradient via HDR→composite
No debug layer errors on resize or present
PIX shows UAV writes to HDR and draw call to copy to swapchain
implementation: Add HDR resource creation helper in App (format R16G16B16A16_FLOAT)
Add a simple Composite pass: root sig with SRV(t0) + sampler(s0)
HLSL pixel shader samples HDR and outputs to RTV
Update DXR render to write UAV = HDR when available; raster fallback clears HDR then composites
notes: Keep sampler linear clamp; viewport from swapchain size
Defer sRGB handling/tonemap to later (TAA phase)
Check barriers: UAV→SRV for composite; RTV→Present for swapchain
test_plan: Run; verify identical visuals pre/post change
Resize window multiple times; ensure no leaks and no debug messages
PIX capture to validate barriers and resource states
